title: "[Feature] "

assignees: ''
---

## What would you like to see

A clear description of the change.

## What problem does this solve

Who does this help, and in what situation? (For example: "Paraprofessionals setting up a new Android tablet keep missing the Play Store install step.")

## Is this in scope for the production RB Switch?

This project intentionally keeps the production hardware/firmware to three mechanical switch inputs — see `README.md`'s "Production scope" section and `CONTRIBUTING.md`. If your request would add hardware capability (a fourth input, sensors, RGB indicators, etc.), please note whether you're proposing it for the production design or as a documented, clearly-separated experimental variant.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or related issues.
